style_preamble: 16:9 widescreen children's fantasy storybook illustration, Studio Ghibli meets Akira Toriyama Dragon Quest art style, warm watercolor wash and fine sepia-umbrian ink contours (#3E2B23) on textured cream cotton paper (#FAF4E8), borderless edge-to-edge, text-free, no labels, no watermarks.

story_website_scenes.brief: Kai pausing calmly at his cozy bedroom computer desk to help a stuck classmate as an emerald vortex of floating code opens, welcoming him into Pythonia beside the Great Wizard.
Misty cobblestone Silent Village square where Hero Kai kneels gently to comfort a frightened child and casts golden print('Hello!') by the stone well as bluebirds sing and Barnaby the Baker smiles.

Inside Grandma Looma's warm sunlit cottage in Loom Forest draped in rainbow ribbons, Grandma Looma at her giant oak loom showing Kai the comma weave while a friendly golden-tan pup sniffs Kai's boots.

Rocky valley Iron Outpost open forge where the stout horned silver-bearded Blacksmith cheers as Kai strikes the ringing anvil to fuse two broken halves into a gleaming IronSword beside the golden pup.
Twilight moss-draped Whispering Forest with glowing mushrooms and fireflies; a luminous blue Forest Spirit parts the brambles as Kai pauses quietly to name his loyal pup String.
Barren grey Cursed Riverbank beside Great Wizard; String sits proudly guarding a golden-padlocked wooden chest (gold = 100) glowing beside Kai's silver Spatial Dimensional Pocket pouch.
Echoing mountain cavern with ruby HP, sapphire Mana, and Gold chests locked at once, followed by the Great Wizard dissolving into emerald starlight beneath a silver-leafed farewell tree.
Colossal crimson red dragon curled fast asleep across bronze Ancient Library doors while the translucent Ghost Librarian whispers 'Shhh!' and traces a glowing # Mute Mark beside Kai and String.

Sunlit Sunnybrook Village after a storm: String wears his glowing teal str scroll collar, the stone int golem lifts logs, the azure float droplet waters crops, and bool flashes beside Kai sharing bread with a hungry goblin.

Subterranean Deep Dwarven Forge lit by molten gold crucibles; hatless fiery-bearded Master Grimsby with twin-forked ginger beard and brass rings fits gleaming Dwarven steel armor onto Kai beside String.
Highland cliff crossroads beneath the towering Eye of Truth stone arch; Dwarven-armored Kai activates glowing parallel == Sight eyes, shattering a glitching mirage road into glass beside String.
Summit plateau with hooded Signpost-Keeper, three wooden signposts (DRAGON, TREASURE, HOME), golden colon (:) gates blazing open, and middle stone barrier dissolving before the Citadel of Core.

Golden sunrise flooding the Citadel of Core; the cracked dark obsidian shell of the Bug King lies open as the tiny emerald Baby Praying Mantis Spell Guardian smiles warmly beside Dwarven-armored Kai and String.
